purpose: Define where AI may assist the return-to-service process, where it must refuse to act, and which decisions remain exclusively human.
claim_boundary: Participant-authored authority contract only. It does not validate a model, appoint an institution, certify equipment, or authorize field operation.

rules.ai_may_zh: 归类故障描述、检查工单字段缺口、检索公开服务说明。
rules.ai_may_en: Classify fault descriptions, check missing work-order fields, and retrieve cleared service guidance.
rules.ai_must_not_zh: 裁定保修责任、拒绝投诉、扩大个人数据采集范围。
rules.ai_must_not_en: Determine warranty liability, dismiss a complaint, or expand personal-data collection.
rules.human_exclusive_zh: 确认受理范围、保修升级、数据访问与投诉路径。
rules.human_exclusive_en: Confirm intake scope, warranty escalation, data access, and complaint routes.

rules.ai_may_zh: 聚类错误码、检索相似工单、建议受控检查顺序。
rules.ai_may_en: Cluster error codes, retrieve similar cases, and suggest a controlled inspection order.
rules.ai_must_not_zh: 判定危险废物属性、允许不安全上电、解除物理隔离。
rules.ai_must_not_en: Classify hazardous waste, permit unsafe energisation, or remove physical isolation.
rules.human_exclusive_zh: 风险分类、隔离、应急处置与资格交接。
rules.human_exclusive_en: Risk classification, isolation, emergency action, and qualified handover.

rules.space_zh: AI 原点互换件公库与校准台
rules.space_en: AI Origin Parts Commons and calibration bench
rules.ai_may_zh: 生成候选部件短名单并标出机械、电气、通信、固件、校准和失效模式证据缺口。
rules.ai_may_en: Shortlist candidate parts and expose gaps across mechanical, electrical, communications, firmware, calibration, and failure-mode evidence.
rules.ai_must_not_zh: 把外观相似当作兼容、隐藏负结果、授权换件。
rules.ai_must_not_en: Treat visual similarity as compatibility, hide negative findings, or authorize replacement.
rules.human_exclusive_zh: 批准维修范围、确认兼容证据与召回处置。
rules.human_exclusive_en: Approve the repair scope, accept compatibility evidence, and handle recalls.

rules.ai_may_zh: 编排已批准测试、比较基线、提示异常与证据缺口。
rules.ai_may_en: Orchestrate approved tests, compare baselines, and flag anomalies or evidence gaps.
rules.ai_must_not_zh: 修改通过阈值、覆盖失败记录、签发校准或安全结论。
rules.ai_must_not_en: Change pass thresholds, overwrite failed evidence, or sign calibration or safety conclusions.
rules.human_exclusive_zh: 急停、校准/测试签认、无障碍接受与残余限制确认。
rules.human_exclusive_en: Emergency stop, calibration/test sign-off, accessibility acceptance, and residual-limit confirmation.

rules.space_zh: 大钟寺人工放行室与重返运行广场
rules.space_en: Dazhongsi human-release room and Return-to-Service Square
rules.ai_may_zh: 检查门链完整性、生成限定回执草稿、聚合不含个人画像的运营指标。
rules.ai_may_en: Check gate-trail completeness, draft a limited receipt, and aggregate non-profile operating metrics.
rules.ai_must_not_zh: 决定复役、代签责任人、把低置信度建议写成专业结论。
rules.ai_must_not_en: Decide return to service, impersonate an accountable signatory, or present low-confidence advice as a professional conclusion.
rules.human_exclusive_zh: 最终暂停、有限放行、退回或资格交接。
rules.human_exclusive_en: Final hold, limited release, return, or qualified handover.
